title: [GMCP 203.013.M] Mastery: MRTR, elicitation, sampling, and roots interaction model
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-013-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: The model-request/tool-response flow fully implements input_required, typed inputRequests, retry with inputResponses, nested elicitation, sampling and roots compatibility, cancellation, deadlines, progress, partial failure, and explicit handle ownership. Every human or model decision is attributable, policy-checked and resumable, and replays cannot duplicate side effects or hijack another principal's handle. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
